biggest_catch: You only get the second $25 if your friend completes ALL THREE benchmarks (e-statements, 10 POS transactions, $500 direct deposit) within 60 days - if they only open the account, you get just $25.
catches: Referring member earns up to $50 in account credit per friend: $25 when the referred member opens an account, plus $25 if they meet all three benchmarks.
Cap: $500 in account credits per calendar year (10 fully-qualified referrals).
Benchmarks: e-statement enrollment + 10 point-of-sale transactions + direct deposit of at least $500, all within 60 days of account opening.
Friend must present the referral card from the current member at account opening; referral must be disclosed at opening; no third-party channels.
Friend must open a new SRU FCU share draft checking account and be approved for membership; no duplicate/re-opened accounts.
Credits applied within 60 calendar days of completion. Offer subject to change or end at any time without notice.
Qualified direct deposit = recurring payroll, Social Security, or pension (no P2P or bank transfers).

steps: Pick up referral cards at SRU FCU and give one to your friend.
Friend presents the referral card at account opening and opens a share draft checking account.
You receive $25 in account credit when the account opens.
If the friend completes all three benchmarks (e-statements, 10 POS transactions, $500 direct deposit) within 60 days, you receive another $25 (up to $500/year).
timing: Account credits applied within 60 calendar days of completion; benchmarks must be met within 60 days of account opening.
